newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine Maniguin third well fails to yield oil.
newsitem.headline: Philippine Maniguin third well fails to yield oil.

text.p: Philippine National Oil Co-Exploration Corp (PNOC-EC) on Friday plugged and abandoned its third well in Maniguin in central Philippines.

"We did not find any oil although the well was just three kilometers away from the second well. We think the reservoir is not as big as we envisioned it to be," Lucio Samonte, PNOC-EC vice-president, told Reuters.

PNOC-EC was expecting to flow more than the 180 barrels of oil per day rate when the second well was drilled. Poor to weak oil shows were encountered soon after PNOC-EC spudded the third well last August 15.
PNOC-EC plans to drill a fourth well this year if members of the consortium agree, Samonte said.

The members include Oriental Petroleum & Minerals Corp, Petrofields Exploration and Development Co Inc, UK-based Dragon Far East and local firm Southwest Resources. --Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 fax 8176267
